poolId: REPLACE: bytes32 pool id from the Initialize log (npm run discover)
launchBlock: REPLACE: block of the Initialize log
imdEthPoolId: OPTIONAL: public ETH/IMD v4 pool id for IMD/USD; remove if unused

distributorTrigger.signature: OPTIONAL: e.g. function release() — the distributor's permissionless trigger; remove if unused

roundPayoutAbi: OPTIONAL: paste the RoundPayout ABI array shipped with the deployment; remove to use the built-in ABI
